column2: fixture-only; extraction bounds only; experimental scatter and model discrepancy unstated; no confidence probability

Automated pixel reads by script (no manual clicking): pass A on the embedded 1890x1260 one-bit 600 ppi CCITT image extracted with pdfimages (ink = 0); passes B and C on Poppler gray renders of the figure region at 300 and 240 dpi (ink = gray < 128); origin top-left, zero-based pixels

log10 axes linear in pixels: x0_pixel and x1_pixel are the left and right frame lines (100 Hz and 10000 Hz); y0_pixel and y1_pixel are the top and bottom frame lines (0.10 and 0.01); printed tick labels

read_x = centre of the vertical error-bar column; read_y = centre of the horizontal error-bar row through a triangle marker (spruce) or midpoint of a square marker's outer top and bottom edges (sycamore)

x_radius = half bar width + half frame-line width + 1 px; y_radius = half |marker midpoint - bar row| + 1 px + half frame-line width; nominal +/- half_width encloses delta(read_y +/- y_radius) of passes A, B and C
